title: South Dakota Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of the state agency that runs South Dakota's business taxes.

title: Online Services (EPath)
purpose: Lists the Department of Revenue's online services, including EPath for filing and paying sales, use and contractor's excise tax.
notes: The department's own guides name the EPath login address as sd.gov/EPath (in-text). New tax licenses are applied for online at apps.sd.gov/rv23cedar/main/main.aspx (named in the 2026 Sales and Use Tax Guide, in-text).

title: No state personal income tax
purpose: South Dakota does not tax individual income.
notes: The DOR's 2026 Sales and Use Tax Guide and business tax page (https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/) state South Dakota has no corporate or personal income tax.

title: No corporate income tax
purpose: South Dakota does not tax corporate income.
notes: DOR business tax page states South Dakota does not impose a corporate income tax. Banks and financial institutions pay a bank franchise tax instead (separate entry).

title: Bank Franchise Tax
purpose: Explains the franchise tax return that banks and other financial institutions doing business in South Dakota must file.
notes: Applies only to financial institutions. The page may be dated; confirm details with DOR.

title: Sales & Use Tax
purpose: Explains South Dakota sales and use tax, who must hold a sales tax license, and how to file.

title: No state income tax withholding
purpose: South Dakota has no income tax, so employers do not withhold state income tax.
notes: Follows from the DOR's statement that the state has no personal income tax.

title: Reemployment Assistance (unemployment insurance) tax
purpose: Department of Labor and Regulation division that handles employer registration, quarterly wage reports and unemployment tax.
agency: South Dakota Department of Labor and Regulation
notes: South Dakota calls unemployment insurance 'Reemployment Assistance.' Employer FAQ: https://dlr.sd.gov/ra/businesses/faq.aspx; wage reporting: https://dlr.sd.gov/ra/businesses/wage_reporting.aspx (both official results).

title: Business Services
purpose: Secretary of State page for forming and registering corporations, LLCs and other business entities.
notes: Business forms: https://sdsos.gov/Division%20of%20Business%20Services/Business%20Forms/default.aspx (official result).

title: Annual reports (Business Services)
purpose: Secretary of State business filing area, where entities file their yearly annual report online or on paper.
notes: No standalone annual report page was found; the Business Services pages and filing-fee schedule (https://sdsos.gov/general-information/filing-fees.aspx) cover the annual report, which is due every year and can be filed online.

title: No general state business license found
purpose: South Dakota does not appear to issue a single statewide general business license.
notes: Searches of SD state sites found no general state business license; requirements depend on activity (e.g., the DOR sales tax license, Secretary of State registration, and industry licenses). Not confirmed by an explicit official statement, so not marked NOT_APPLICABLE.

title: Alcohol licensing
purpose: Department of Revenue page on state alcohol licenses for manufacturers, wholesalers, carriers and wine shippers.
notes: Retail on-sale/off-sale licenses are issued locally (city finance officer or county auditor). Retailers page: https://dor.sd.gov/businesses/taxes/alcohol/liquor-retailers-other-liquor-licenses/ (official result).

title: Alcohol taxes
purpose: Department of Revenue page covering alcohol licensing and the related alcohol taxes.
notes: Agency: South Dakota Department of Revenue. Renewals and filings go through the DOR online portal.

title: Nonprofit Corporations
purpose: Secretary of State forms and filing information for forming a South Dakota nonprofit corporation.

title: No charity registration required
purpose: South Dakota does not require charities to register before asking for donations.
agency: South Dakota Attorney General, Division of Consumer Protection
notes: The AG's Consumer Protection page states SD has no licensing or registration requirements for nonprofit or charitable organizations. Paid solicitors must register with the AG (SDCL 37-30).

title: Tennessee Department of Revenue
purpose: Home page of the state agency that runs Tennessee's taxes.
notes: Many tn.gov/revenue/... pages appeared as official results, but the home page URL itself did not.

title: Tennessee Taxpayer Access Point (TNTAP)
purpose: Online system to register for, file and pay Tennessee business taxes.
notes: Department of Revenue pages name TNTAP at tntap.tn.gov; all sales and use tax returns must be filed through TNTAP.

title: No individual income tax (Hall tax repealed)
purpose: Explains the former Hall income tax on interest and dividends, repealed for tax years beginning January 1, 2021 or later.
notes: Tennessee does not tax wages. The Hall income tax was repealed for periods beginning on or after Jan 1, 2021 (TDOR HIT-3).

title: Franchise & Excise Tax
purpose: Explains Tennessee's franchise tax (on net worth) and excise tax (on net earnings) owed by corporations, LLCs and similar entities.
notes: Tennessee also has a gross-receipts 'business tax' (see BUSINESS_LICENSE entry).

title: Sales and Use Tax
purpose: Explains Tennessee sales and use tax registration, rates and filing.

title: No state income tax withholding
purpose: Tennessee has no income tax on earned income, so employers do not withhold state income tax.
notes: TDOR GEN-34 states Tennessee has no state income tax on earned income and therefore no withholding requirements.

title: Unemployment Insurance Tax
purpose: Explains employer registration, premium and wage reporting, and payment of Tennessee unemployment insurance tax.
agency: Tennessee Department of Labor and Workforce Development
notes: Reports and payments are now filed in Employer e-Services on jobs4TN.gov (TNPAWS was retired in 2025).

title: Business Forms & Fees
purpose: Secretary of State page listing forms and fees for forming and registering business entities in Tennessee.
notes: Online filings use the TNCaB portal: https://tncab.tnsos.gov/ (official result).

title: Annual Report Instructions
purpose: Secretary of State instructions for filing a business entity's annual report.
notes: A TNCaB account is required to file online.

title: Business Tax Registration and Licensing
purpose: Explains Tennessee business tax registration and the business licenses that county clerks and city officials issue.
notes: The Department of Revenue does not issue business licenses itself; they are issued by county clerks/city officials, while the gross-receipts business tax is registered and filed with TDOR.

title: TABC Licensing
purpose: Tennessee Alcoholic Beverage Commission page for liquor, wine and high-gravity-beer licenses.
notes: TABC does not issue regular beer permits; those come from local beer boards.

title: Alcoholic Beverage Taxes - Registration and Licensing
purpose: Department of Revenue page on registering for Tennessee alcoholic beverage taxes.
notes: Agency: Tennessee Department of Revenue; returns filed through TNTAP. Liquor-by-the-drink tax and beer barrelage tax are also TDOR taxes (separate entry).

title: Liquor-by-the-Drink Tax - Registration and Licensing
purpose: Department of Revenue page on registering for the tax on alcohol sold for on-premises consumption.

title: How do I register a nonprofit in Tennessee?
purpose: Secretary of State guidance on filing a charter to form a Tennessee nonprofit corporation.

title: Register or Renew a Charity Online
purpose: Secretary of State service for registering or renewing a charitable organization that solicits in Tennessee.
agency: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Charitable Solicitations and Gaming

title: Texas Comptroller of Public Accounts
purpose: Home page of the state agency that collects most Texas taxes.

title: File and Pay (Webfile / eSystems)
purpose: Comptroller page for filing and paying Texas taxes online through Webfile.
notes: Webfile is reached by logging into Comptroller eSystems. Getting started: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/file-pay/about-webfile.php (official result).

title: No state personal income tax
purpose: Texas does not tax individual income.
notes: Listed as having no such tax in the research brief; not source-checked this pass (search budget ran out).

title: Franchise Tax
purpose: Explains the Texas franchise tax that most businesses file each year with the Comptroller.
notes: Texas has no corporate income tax; the franchise tax is its main business tax.

title: Sales and Use Tax
purpose: Explains Texas sales and use tax rates, permits and filing.
notes: Permit application: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/permit/ (official result).

title: No state income tax withholding
purpose: Texas has no income tax, so employers do not withhold state income tax.
notes: Listed as having no such tax in the research brief; not source-checked this pass (search budget ran out).

title: Unemployment Tax Program
purpose: Texas Workforce Commission page on employer unemployment tax registration, wage reports and payments.
notes: Current online system is Unemployment Tax Services (https://www.twc.texas.gov/services/manage-tax); TWC has announced a replacement system, TxUS.

title: Business Services
purpose: Secretary of State page for forming and registering business entities in Texas.
notes: Online filings are moving from SOSDirect to SOSPortal; some SOS pages still mention SOSDirect.

title: Public Information Report (PIR) and Ownership Information Report (OIR)
purpose: Comptroller page explaining the information report most entities file each year along with the franchise tax report.
notes: Texas uses the PIR/OIR filed with the Comptroller (due with the franchise tax report) rather than a separate Secretary of State annual report for these entities. Required even when no franchise tax is due.

title: No general state business license confirmed
purpose: Texas does not appear to issue a single general state business license.
notes: No official page confirming a general state business license (or its absence) was found. The Comptroller says businesses must determine which federal, state and local licenses apply. Sales tax permit: https://comptroller.texas.gov/taxes/permit/.

title: TABC Licenses and Permits
purpose: Texas Alcoholic Beverage Commission page for applying for and managing alcohol licenses and permits.
notes: Applications are filed online in AIMS: https://www.tabc.texas.gov/services/alcohol-industry-management-system-aims/.

title: Alcohol Excise Taxes
purpose: TABC page on the excise tax reports that manufacturers, distributors and wholesalers file.
notes: Excise taxes on beer, wine and spirits are reported to TABC. Mixed beverage taxes are a separate Comptroller tax (next entry).

title: Mixed Beverage Taxes FAQ
purpose: Comptroller answers about the mixed beverage gross receipts tax and mixed beverage sales tax owed by permit holders.
notes: Filed with the Comptroller (Webfile).

title: Nonprofit Organizations FAQs
purpose: Secretary of State answers about forming a Texas nonprofit corporation (Form 202, Certificate of Formation).
notes: Form 202 instructions: https://www.sos.texas.gov/corp/instructions/202.shtml (official result).

title: Charitable Trusts - Registration and Filings
purpose: Attorney General page explaining that most Texas charities do not register with the state, and listing the exceptions.
agency: Office of the Texas Attorney General
notes: Most charities need not register. Exceptions: certain law-enforcement-related organizations soliciting by phone, public safety organizations and their solicitors, and veterans organizations and their solicitors.

title: Utah State Tax Commission
purpose: Home page of the state agency that runs Utah's taxes.
notes: Many tax.utah.gov pages appeared as official results, but the home page itself did not.

title: Taxpayer Access Point (TAP) - getting started
purpose: Tax Commission page explaining how to use TAP to register, file and pay Utah taxes online.
notes: This is the TAP information page; the TAP login address itself was not confirmed.

title: Utah individual income tax
purpose: Information on filing the Utah individual income tax return (TC-40).
notes: Best-known official address; did not appear in search results.

title: C Corporation Tax
purpose: Explains the Utah corporate franchise and income tax return (TC-20) that corporations doing business in Utah file.

title: Sales & Use Tax
purpose: Tax Commission page explaining Utah sales and use tax.
notes: Publication 25 (general information): https://tax.utah.gov/forms-pubs/pub-25/.

title: Utah Withholding Taxes
purpose: Explains how employers get a Utah withholding account and file and pay withholding.

title: Employer Overview - Unemployment Insurance
purpose: Department of Workforce Services page for employers on unemployment insurance accounts, reports and contributions.
notes: Employer registration: https://jobs.utah.gov/ui/employer/public/osbr.aspx (official result).

title: Online Registration Instructions
purpose: Division of Corporations instructions for registering a business entity online in Utah.
agency: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code

title: Renewal Process
purpose: Division of Corporations page explaining the annual renewal that keeps a Utah entity active.
agency: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code
notes: Utah calls the annual report a 'renewal.'

title: No state general business license
purpose: Utah does not issue a general state business license; cities and counties issue local business licenses.
notes: Department of Commerce states cities handle business licenses (counties for unincorporated areas). State registration with Tax Commission, Commerce and Workforce Services is done through OneStop Business Registration. Industry/professional licenses may still apply.

title: Retail Licenses
purpose: Department of Alcoholic Beverage Services page on applying for and renewing retail alcohol licenses.
agency: Utah Department of Alcoholic Beverage Services (DABS)
notes: Distributor and industry applications: https://abs.utah.gov/licenses-permits/applications-renewals/distributors-industry/ (official result).

title: Beer Tax
purpose: Tax Commission page on the beer tax that brewers, importers and distributors report monthly.
notes: Agency: Utah State Tax Commission. Liquor, wine and flavored malt beverages are sold through state stores with a DABS markup rather than a separate filed tax.

title: Domestic Non-Profit Corporation
purpose: Division of Corporations page for forming and maintaining a Utah nonprofit corporation.
agency: Utah Department of Commerce, Division of Corporations and Commercial Code

title: Charities
purpose: Department of Commerce page on Utah charity requirements, now handled through the Division of Corporations.
agency: Utah Department of Commerce (Division of Corporations and Commercial Code; Division of Consumer Protection enforces)
notes: H.B. 43 (2024) ended separate charity registration with the Division of Consumer Protection; since Jan 1, 2025 nonprofits register with the Division of Corporations and upload their latest IRS Form 990-series return at renewal. Professional fundraisers still register with Consumer Protection.
